      SUBROUTINE MAT (IELID)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER IELID
      INTEGER MATID, INFLAG
      REAL ELTEMP, STRESS, SINTH, COSTH
      COMMON /MATIN / MATID, INFLAG, ELTEMP, STRESS,
     1  SINTH, COSTH
      REAL G11, G12, G13, G22, G23, G33, RHO
      REAL ALPHA1, ALPHA2, ALP12, TSUB0, GSUBE
      REAL SIGTEN, SIGCOM, SIGSHE
      REAL G2X211, G2X212, G2X222
      COMMON /MATOUT/ G11, G12, G13, G22, G23, G33, RHO,
     1  ALPHA1, ALPHA2, ALP12, TSUB0, GSUBE,
     2  SIGTEN, SIGCOM, SIGSHE, G2X211, G2X212, G2X222
      REAL EE, NU, FAC
      EE = 2e+11
      NU = 0.3
      IF (INFLAG .EQ. 3) THEN
        G2X211 = 0.0
        G2X212 = 0.0
        G2X222 = 0.0
      ELSE
        FAC = EE / (1.0 - NU*NU)
        G11 = FAC
        G12 = NU * FAC
        G13 = 0.0
        G22 = FAC
        G23 = 0.0
        G33 = FAC * (1.0 - NU) / 2.0
      END IF
      RHO = 7800.0
      ALPHA1 = 12.0E-6
      ALPHA2 = 12.0E-6
      ALP12 = 0.0
      TSUB0 = 20.0
      GSUBE = 0.0
      SIGTEN = 0.0
      SIGCOM = 0.0
      SIGSHE = 0.0
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE SMA1B (KIJ, IGRID, ICODE, IFFILE,
     1  FACTOR)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KIJ(6,6), FACTOR
      INTEGER IGRID, ICODE, IFFILE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KSTORE(6,6,4,4)
      INTEGER CURPVT, NPVTS
      COMMON /CAPTUREP/ KSTORE, CURPVT, NPVTS
      REAL ECPT(100)
      INTEGER NECPT(100)
      EQUIVALENCE (NECPT(1), ECPT(1))
      COMMON /SMA1ET/ ECPT
      INTEGER IOPT4, K4GGSW, NPVT
      REAL DUMCL(7)
      INTEGER LINK(10), IDETCK
      REAL DODET
      INTEGER NOGO
      COMMON /SMA1CL/ IOPT4, K4GGSW, NPVT, DUMCL, LINK,
     1  IDETCK, DODET, NOGO
      INTEGER I, J, IPVT, IGRP
      IF (FACTOR .NE. 0.0D0) RETURN
      DO 10 IPVT = 1, NPVTS
        IF (NPVT .EQ. NECPT(IPVT+1)) GO TO 20
   10 CONTINUE
      WRITE(6,*) 'SMA1B WARNING pivot', NPVT
      RETURN
   20 DO 30 IGRP = 1, NPVTS
        IF (IGRID .EQ. NECPT(IGRP+1)) GO TO 40
   30 CONTINUE
      WRITE(6,*) 'SMA1B WARNING grid', IGRID
      RETURN
   40 DO 50 I = 1, 6
        DO 50 J = 1, 6
          KSTORE(I, J, IPVT, IGRP) = KIJ(I, J)
   50 CONTINUE
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE TRANSD (ICSID, T)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER ICSID
      DOUBLE PRECISION T(9)
      T(1)=1.0D0; T(2)=0.0D0; T(3)=0.0D0
      T(4)=0.0D0; T(5)=1.0D0; T(6)=0.0D0
      T(7)=0.0D0; T(8)=0.0D0; T(9)=1.0D0
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE MESAGE (ICODE, IMSG, IPARM)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER ICODE, IMSG, IPARM(2)
      WRITE(6,*) 'MESAGE code=', ICODE, ' msg=', IMSG
      RETURN
      END
